scenarios.name: Retry after error
scenarios.what: Sends the event, then the provider's retry 2 s after it completes. Providers retry when a delivery fails or takes too long; your handler can't tell which.

findings.title: Accepts tampered payload
findings.summary: D12 changed amount_paid from 2400 to 0 and was signed for the original body. Your handler returned 200 in 167 ms and created an order: orders.count 0 → 1, expected a 4xx and no change.
findings.measured: HTTP 200 in 167 ms · orders.count 0 → 1 · expected: a 4xx and no change
findings.why: Stripe signs the exact bytes it sends. If a failed check doesn't stop the request, anyone who can reach this URL can create paid orders.
findings.cause_hint: Late (D9) was rejected, so the timestamp check runs; the signature check probably fails into a log line instead of stopping the request.
findings.fix_note: Return 400 as soon as constructEvent throws, before any write. After the fix, D12 should get 400 and leave orders.count at 0.

findings.title: Duplicate delivery created a second order
findings.caption: Same request, same response, a different state.
findings.summary: D5 delivered the same invoice.paid event as D4. Both got 200 {"received":true}, but orders.count went 1 → 2, expected 1. The retry D11 did the same after D10. Only the probe could see this.
findings.measured: D5: HTTP 200 in 196 ms · orders.count 1 → 2, expected 1 · D11 (retry): HTTP 200 in 205 ms · orders.count 1 → 2, expected 1
findings.why: Stripe may deliver the same event more than once, and retries failed or timed-out deliveries with backoff for up to 3 days in live mode. Each duplicate creates another order.
findings.citation: Stripe docs › Webhooks › Handle duplicate events · Retry behavior
findings.cause_hint: The handler doesn't record the event id before it writes.
findings.fix_note: Record event.id before creating the order and return 200 early when it is already recorded. After the fix, D5 and D11 should leave orders.count at 1.

findings.title: Over the 10 s budget for Stripe
findings.summary: 2 of 8 valid invoice.paid deliveries took longer than the 10 s budget (Webhook Trap default): D10 (11 840 ms) and D16 (10 420 ms). Stripe doesn't publish its timeout, so these are over our default budget, not proven failures at Stripe.
findings.measured: D10 11 840 ms (+1 840 over) · D16 10 420 ms (+420 over) · median of the other 6 valid invoice.paid deliveries 202 ms
findings.why: If Stripe times out waiting, the delivery counts as failed and is retried. Stripe doesn't publish the timeout. In this run, D10 went over our default budget, and the retry D11 created the duplicate order in F2.
findings.citation: Stripe docs › Webhooks › Quickly return a 2xx response
findings.cause_hint: Only some deliveries of invoice.paid were slow, so the slow step is intermittent: usually an external call or a lock wait before the response.
findings.fix_note: Acknowledge with 200 first, then queue the slow work. After the fix, D10 and D16 should respond within the budget.
findings.fix:
res.sendStatus(200);            // acknowledge first
await queue.add('create-label', { invoiceId: event.data.object.id });

findings.title: Probe doesn't see subscription state
findings.summary: Shuffled and Burst passed on orders.count. But customer.subscription.updated was delivered first in Shuffled (D6) and inside the burst (D15), and no probe reads subscription state.
findings.measured: orders.count 0 → 1 after Shuffled and after Burst, expected 1 · subscription state not measured
findings.why: Out-of-order delivery usually breaks status fields, not counts.
findings.fix_note: Add subscriptions.status to the probe in webhooktrap.yml. The next run then checks both.
findings.fix:
probe:
  # keep your existing entries, then add:
  - as: subscriptions.status
    sql: select status from subscriptions where stripe_id = '{{subscription.id}}'

new_pill.label: 3 new deliveries
new_pill.helper: Press N or click to jump to the newest.

paused.label: Catching up
paused.helper: 6 deliveries arrived while this tab was hidden. Showing them now.

stream_lost.label: Live updates interrupted
stream_lost.helper: Reconnecting… Deliveries are still being captured on our side and will appear when the connection returns. Last update 14:07:51.

quota.label: Guest limit reached: 100 of 100 deliveries
quota.helper: New deliveries are still answered (your provider sees 200) but not stored. Save the ones you need as fixtures, or sign in to keep capturing.

expired.label: This guest URL expired
expired.helper: Guest captures are kept for 24 hours. This one ended at 14:02 on Nov 12. Get a new URL, or sign in so URLs don't expire.

body_not_kept.label: Body not kept (12.4 MB, limit 5 MB)
body_not_kept.helper: Headers and a SHA-256 of the body are stored. The body itself was not.

binary.label: Binary body (application/octet-stream, 48 KB)
binary.helper: Shown as hex. Download the exact bytes.

no_results.label: No deliveries match “invoice.voided”
no_results.helper: Clear the filter to see all 13.

invalid.label: Signature invalid
invalid.helper: Signed with a different secret. See the reason and fix.

no_secret.label: No secret
no_secret.helper: Signed by Parcelbird, but no secret is set on your agent, so we can't check it.

unknown.label: Unknown scheme
unknown.helper: There is a signature-like header (X-Signature) but we don't recognise the scheme. Define it to check it.

unsigned.label: Unsigned
unsigned.helper: No signature header. Nothing to check.

no_agent.label: Not checked
no_agent.helper: Secrets live on your machine. Connect the agent to check signatures.

not_installed.label: No agent connected
not_installed.helper: The agent runs on your machine, sends deliveries to localhost and keeps your signing secrets there.

pairing.label: Waiting for your agent…
pairing.helper: Run the command in a terminal. Code 7KQ2M-XR9TD expires in 9:41.

awaiting_confirmation.label: Confirm in your terminal
awaiting_confirmation.helper: maya-mbp is waiting for you to type y in the terminal where you ran the command. Check that it shows https://webhooktrap.dev first.

needs_reconfirm.label: Confirm in your terminal
needs_reconfirm.helper: This session moved to your account, so maya-mbp asks you to confirm the new workspace in its terminal. It runs nothing until you do.

pair_declined.label: Pairing cancelled
pair_declined.helper: The agent was not paired: someone answered N in the terminal. Get a new code to try again.

offline_finished_run.label: maya-mbp is offline
offline_finished_run.helper: This run is complete and shown as the server stored it. Run again and Save as fixtures need maya-mbp. Last seen 14:31:07.

signatures_checked.label: Signatures checked
signatures_checked.helper: Signatures checked: 4 of 4 valid with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET on maya-mbp.

unreachable_refused.label: Target unreachable
unreachable_refused.helper: maya-mbp got 'connection refused' from localhost:3000. Is your app running?

unreachable_tls.label: Target unreachable
unreachable_tls.helper: TLS error on https://localhost:3443: self-signed certificate. Use http:// for localhost or pass --insecure-localhost.

lost_mid_run.label: Agent disconnected
lost_mid_run.helper: maya-mbp stopped responding at 13:57:04.120 during D3 of 16. D1–D2 and their results are kept. Reconnect to run it again.

too_old.label: Agent update needed
too_old.helper: maya-mbp runs 0.7.4. This run needs 0.9 or later: npx @webhooktrap/agent@latest

replaced.label: Agent replaced
replaced.helper: A new agent paired with this guest session, so maya-mbp was disconnected. A guest session has one agent at a time.

draft_over_cap.label: Too many deliveries
draft_over_cap.helper: This run would send 54 deliveries. The limit is 50.

draft_two_providers.label: Select events from one provider
draft_two_providers.helper: A run tests one provider at a time. Remove the Shopify events, or prove them in their own run.

needs_secret.label: Needs secret
needs_secret.helper: Stripe signs a timestamp, so nothing can be replayed without STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET on maya-mbp.

side_effects.label: This run repeats events
side_effects.helper: This run sends the same events several times. If your handler sends emails or charges cards, honour the Webhooktrap-Dry-Run header first.

queued.label: Queued
queued.helper: Waiting for maya-mbp to accept the run…

queued_confirm.label: Queued
queued_confirm.helper: Confirm in maya-mbp's terminal: it shows the probe and reset commands from webhooktrap.yml and this target before it runs them.

checks_hosted.label: What was checked
checks_hosted.helper: Level 1 transport · Level 2 probe orders.count (count) · reset before every scenario, run on maya-mbp

passed.label: Passed · 1 Info
passed.helper: 9 of 9 scenarios passed at Level 1 + Level 2 (orders.count). Not checked: subscription state, which no probe reads · side effects outside your database, such as emails.

aborted.label: Aborted
aborted.helper: Agent lost during D3 of 16. D1–D2 are kept.

aborted_target_lost.label: Aborted
aborted_target_lost.helper: 3 deliveries in a row couldn't connect to localhost:3000 (D9 to D11). Completed deliveries and findings are kept.

aborted_reset_failed.label: Aborted
aborted_reset_failed.helper: The reset before Tampered failed on maya-mbp. D1–D11 and their findings are kept. The command and its output are in the agent's terminal.
aborted_reset_failed.cli: The reset before Tampered failed: npm run db:reset:webhooks exited with code 1. D1–D11 and their findings are kept.

aborted_time_limit.label: Aborted
aborted_time_limit.helper: The run reached the 15-minute limit during Burst. Completed deliveries and findings are kept.

aborted_user.label: Aborted
aborted_user.helper: Stopped with Ctrl-C during D7. D1–D6 and their findings are kept.

inconclusive.label: Inconclusive
inconclusive.helper: Responses are identical, but we can't see your database. Add a probe to check for duplicate side effects.

order_dependent.label: Order-dependent
order_dependent.helper: No reset ran between scenarios, so results may depend on earlier ones. Add reset: to webhooktrap.yml.

start_failed.label: Couldn't start the run
start_failed.helper: maya-mbp refused the job: target localhost:3000/webhooks/stripe isn't in its allow-list. Run: webhooktrap targets add localhost:3000

couldnt_start_baseline_rejected.label: Couldn't start the run
couldnt_start_baseline_rejected.helper: Your handler rejected a correctly signed delivery (HTTP 401). Check the secret on maya-mbp and the target path.

couldnt_start_target_unreachable.label: Couldn't start the run
couldnt_start_target_unreachable.helper: maya-mbp couldn't connect to localhost:3000 for 5 s (connection refused). Nothing else was sent. Is your app running?

couldnt_start_probe_unstable.label: Couldn't start the run
couldnt_start_probe_unstable.helper: Your probe isn't stable: its value changed with no delivery. Remove time-based values such as updated_at or now().

couldnt_start_reset_failed.label: Couldn't start the run
couldnt_start_reset_failed.helper: The reset failed on maya-mbp before the first delivery. Nothing was sent. The command and its output are in the agent's terminal.
couldnt_start_reset_failed.cli: The reset failed before the first delivery: npm run db:reset:webhooks exited with code 1. Nothing was sent.

couldnt_start_needs_secret.label: Couldn't start the run
couldnt_start_needs_secret.helper: Stripe signs a timestamp, so nothing can be replayed without STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET on maya-mbp.

couldnt_start_agent_too_old.label: Couldn't start the run
couldnt_start_agent_too_old.helper: maya-mbp runs 0.7.4. This run needs 0.9 or later: npx @webhooktrap/agent@latest

needs_probe.label: — Inconclusive
needs_probe.helper: Both responses were 2xx. Add a probe to see what the handler did to your state.

needs_reset.label: — Inconclusive
needs_reset.helper: Comparing with the baseline needs a reset between scenarios. Add reset: to webhooktrap.yml.

probe_failed.label: — Inconclusive
probe_failed.helper: Probe failed 3 times in a row; continuing at Level 1.

not_simultaneous.label: — Inconclusive
not_simultaneous.helper: The deliveries left 34 ms apart, more than the 20 ms a burst allows. Not judged at Level 2.

redirected.label: — Inconclusive
redirected.helper: The handler answered 302, so we can't tell whether it rejected the delivery.

unsettled.label: — Inconclusive
unsettled.helper: orders.count changed 1 s after the last response. Your handler probably writes in a background job. Set settle: 2s in webhooktrap.yml.

unreachable.label: Unreachable
unreachable.helper: maya-mbp couldn't connect to localhost:3000 for this delivery (connection refused). Not judged.

needs_probe.title: Add a probe to see state
needs_probe.helper: Twice got 200 twice, but nothing reads your database, so a duplicate side effect can't be seen.

order_dependent.title: Results may depend on order
order_dependent.helper: No reset ran between scenarios. Add reset: to webhooktrap.yml.

probe_gap.title: Probe doesn't see subscription state
probe_gap.helper: customer.subscription.updated changes subscription state, which no probe reads.

cold_start.title: First delivery was slow
cold_start.helper: D1 took 12 300 ms, later deliveries ≤ 238 ms. Likely a cold start, such as a dev server compiling the route. Not counted.

async_write.title: Handler writes after it responds
async_write.helper: orders.count changed 1 s after the last response. Your handler probably writes in a background job. Set settle: 2s in webhooktrap.yml.

meter.label: Guest session · expires in 23 h 49 m · 13/100 deliveries · 1/10 runs

meter_waiting.label: Guest session · expires in 23 h 59 m · 0/100 deliveries · 0/10 runs

meter_first_four.label: Guest session · expires in 23 h 57 m · 4/100 deliveries · 0/10 runs

ending_soon.label: Ends in 1 h
ending_soon.helper: This session ends in 1 h. Save fixtures or sign in to keep it.

run_quota.label: 10 of 10 guest runs used
run_quota.helper: Sign in to keep running. Runs that couldn't start don't count.

run_too_late.label: Session ends in 4 min
run_too_late.helper: A run can't start in the last 5 minutes of a guest session. Sign in to keep this session.

expired_mid_run.label: Guest session ended
expired_mid_run.helper: The session reached 24 hours during the run, so the run stopped and everything was deleted.

claimed.label: Guest session moved to your account
claimed.helper: Your deliveries, runs and agent are now in the project 'Stripe project'. The URLs didn't change. Share links were turned off; share again to get new ones. Confirm the new workspace in maya-mbp's terminal.

not_saved.label: Not saved
not_saved.helper: Save these 3 events as scrubbed fixtures in your repo.

drifted.label: Shape drifted
drifted.helper: customer.subscription.updated now has cancellation_details.feedback, which isn't in your fixture.

config_note.label: Probe values
config_note.helper: Probe values stay on your machine. The web app shows counts up to 9 999 as numbers and other values as short codes such as #a1f3c0, which only show whether a value changed.

tag_count.label: count
tag_count.helper: Shown as a number on the web.

tag_code.label: code
tag_code.helper: Shown as a code on the web, such as #a1f3c0.

tag_shown.label: shown (show: value)
tag_shown.helper: Shown on your private run page. Shared links show a code unless you include probe values.

code_tooltip.label: #a1f3c0
code_tooltip.helper: Code for a value that stays on your machine. Same code = same value within this run.

invalid.label: #invalid
invalid.helper: The server refused this value, so it isn't shown.

guest_show_ignored.label: show: ignored
guest_show_ignored.helper: show: is ignored for guest sessions; sign in to use it

show_fallback.label: Shown as a code
show_fallback.helper: customer.email is marked show: value, but its value looks like personal data, so the web app shows a code.

lint_name.label: Probe name
lint_name.helper: Probe names are visible in the web app and on shared links.

lint_unscoped.label: Whole-table probe
lint_unscoped.helper: This probe reads the whole table. Its value can reveal your volume over time. Scope it with {{invoice.id}}.

private.label: Only people in this project
private.helper: The run page needs a sign-in.

link.label: Anyone with the link
link.helper: People with the link see probe names and counts. Other values show as codes, and signing secrets never leave your machine.

hide_bodies.label: Hide request and response bodies
hide_bodies.helper: Fields your provider pack marks as personal are always hidden.

include_probe_values.label: Include probe values
include_probe_values.helper: Also shows the values you marked show: in webhooktrap.yml: subscriptions.status.

guest_note.label: Guest link
guest_note.helper: This link stops working when your guest session ends or when you sign in.

new_link.label: Create a new link
new_link.helper: The current link stops working at once.

rotated.label: New link ready
rotated.helper: The old link now shows Not found.

stop.label: Stop sharing
stop.helper: The link now shows Not found.

copied.label: Copied
copied.helper: Share link copied. Anyone with the link can see this run.

ci_private.label: Uploaded privately
ci_private.helper: Uploaded runs are private. Add --share to get a link anyone can open.

agent_web.label: Run by maya-mbp from the web app
agent_web.helper: Results come from the machine that ran them. Webhook Trap re-checks status codes and timings only.

agent_cli.label: Run by maya-mbp from the CLI

server_public.label: Run by the Webhook Trap server runner

server_allowlist.label: Run by the Webhook Trap server runner
server_allowlist.helper: Self-host: private destinations allowed for this user (B′).

judged_on.label: Level 2 · judged on maya-mbp
judged_on.helper: Finding header for Level 2 findings (RUN-9); "judged in CI" for CI runs. Never "verified".

server.label: Something went wrong on our side
server.helper: Your deliveries are safe. Retry, or check status.webhooktrap.dev. Ref 7F3K-21QX.

offline.label: You're offline
offline.helper: Showing what was loaded at 14:07. Live updates resume when you're back.

not_found.label: Delivery not found
not_found.helper: It may have expired with its guest session, or the link is wrong.

read_only.label: Read-only shared run
read_only.helper: Shared by Maya Lindqvist. Sign in to run it again on your own agent.

example.label: Example run
example.helper: A real run against a deliberately buggy handler. Get a URL to prove your own.

not_found_run.label: Not found
not_found_run.helper: This run doesn't exist or isn't shared with you. Guest runs are kept for 24 hours.
